scriptItem.label: Batch Rename Files (String Weaver)
scriptItem.scriptCode:
from importlib import reload from nodeweaver.stringweaver import stringweaver reload(stringweaver)
window = stringweaver.StringWeaver() # Pre-select File Paths provider idx = window._provider_combo.findData("file_paths") if idx >= 0: window._provider_combo.setCurrentIndex(idx) window.showWindow()
